task: Cover the budget envelopes page (`/`): three cards (Groceries $120 of $300, Transport $150 of $150, Fun $0 of $100). Adding spending to an envelope raises its `$spent of $limit` line and its progress bar's aria-valuenow (the percentage of the limit, capped at 100), and the Total line (`Total $270 of $550`) sums every envelope. An envelope whose spending exceeds its limit shows the Over budget badge; spending exactly the limit does not. Reset envelope sets its spending back to $0 and removes the badge. Spending is stored on the server and survives a reload.
